whyItMatters: Without Referrer-Policy, browsers may send full page URLs to third parties, leaking tokens or identifiers carried in query strings.
actions: Send Referrer-Policy: strict-origin-when-cross-origin or tighter on every response.
Keep sensitive identifiers out of URLs regardless of policy.
Re-run a passive DAST scan to confirm the header is observed.
verification: A new passive DAST scan observes Referrer-Policy on the target's responses.
